# Keybindings

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask keybinding-docs` from src/keybindings.rs. -->

Press `?` in lean-tui to see the bindings of the current view.

## Global

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `?` | toggle help |
| `[/]` | cycle display mode |
| `i/o` | toggle input/output panes |
| `m` | cycle timing metrics |
| `g` | goto origin |
| `y` | copy to clipboard |
| `f` | select file |
| `F` | toggle follow mode |
| `L` | toggle legend |
| `Esc` | close popup |
| `q` | quit |

## Compact

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `jk` | select hypothesis or goal |
| `p` | toggle previous step |
| `n` | toggle next step |

## Compact tree

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `jk` | select hypothesis or goal |
| `hl` | scroll steps |

## Semantic tableau

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `hjkl` | navigate |
| `t` | flip tree orientation |

## Data flow

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `hjkl` | navigate |
| `t` | flip tree orientation |

## Effect flow

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `hjkl` | navigate |
| `e` | expand pure steps |

## File picker

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `↑/↓` | select |
| `Enter` | connect |
| `r` | rescan |
| `Esc` | cancel |
